# Support

For help with vhybecheck, email [support@goldshorts.com](mailto:support@goldshorts.com).

You can also [report a bug](https://github.com/emeacham/vhybecheck-issues/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml), [request a feature](https://github.com/emeacham/vhybecheck-issues/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml), or [browse known issues](https://github.com/emeacham/vhybecheck-issues/issues).

[Download the latest version](https://vhybecheck.app/#get).
